subScores.name: Demand
subScores.note: Closings fell 9.6% and pending contracts dropped 11%, the clearest signs of softening buyer momentum this week.

subScores.name: Seller Strength
subScores.note: The average sold-to-list ratio actually strengthened to 104.8%, but 1,101 active listings still carry a price cut, keeping this component in check.

subScores.name: Market Speed
subScores.note: Average days on market rose from 28 to 31, a real, if modest, slowdown in pace.

subScores.name: Rate Environment
subScores.note: The 30-year fixed hit 6.58%, a fourth consecutive weekly increase and the highest level since August 2025.
